newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 4.83 pct.
newsitem.headline: HK 182-day bills average accepted yield 4.83 pct.

text.p: The average accepted yield of 182-day Exchange Fund bills at Tuesday's tender was 4.83 percent, the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said.
This compares with six-month HIBOR of 5.65385 percent at 0330 GMT and the average accepted yield of 4.64 percent at the previous tender on December 31.
Bids for the HK$1 billion issue totalled HK$3.93 billion against HK$3.89 billion in the last tender.
The average accepted yield of 90-day bills was 4.58 percent, compared with three-month HIBOR of 5.48558 percent and the average accepted yield of 4.51 percent at the tender last week.
Bids for the HK$2 billion issue was HK$7.38 billion, down from HK$9.39 billion at the previous tender, the HKMA said.
